# Zero Energy Project

> > A comprehensive resource for zero energy and zero carbon home design, construction, and advocacy, featuring building science, electrification strategies, and climate action initiatives.

Zero Energy Project provides technical guides, case studies, and advocacy resources for homeowners, builders, and policymakers working toward net-zero energy homes and carbon-neutral communities. The site covers building codes, renewable energy systems, energy-efficient construction techniques, and the transition from fossil fuels to all-electric homes.

## Key Topics

- Zero Energy Homes
- Net-Zero vs Passive House
- Home Electrification
- Decarbonization
- Building Science
- Solar Energy
- Energy Efficiency
- Carbon Emissions Reduction
- Building Codes
- Climate Action
- Green Building
- Demand Response
- Heat Pumps
- Advanced Framing
- Zero Carbon Communities

## Technical Guides & Building Science

- [Creating Your Home Electrification Plan: A Step-By-Step Guide](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2024/06/20/creating-your-home-electrification-plan-a-step-by-step-guide): Step-by-step guide to home electrification and decarbonization planning
- [Net-Zero vs Passive House: What are the Similarities and Differences?](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2022/01/14/net-zero-vs-passive-house-what-are-the-similarities-and-differences): Comparison guide: Net-Zero homes vs Passive House standards and practices
- [Simple Techniques for Lowering the Cost of Zero Energy Homes](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2017/07/24/simple-techniques-lowering-cost-zero-energy-homes): Cost reduction techniques: advanced framing and mini-split heat pumps
- [High-R Walls, Part 2: Moisture Content](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2016/01/27/high-r-walls-part-2-moisture-content): Technical guide on moisture management in high-R double-stud walls
- [Landscaping for Energy Efficiency](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2014/10/01/landscaping-for-energy-efficiency): Energy-efficient landscaping strategies for passive design and climate zones

## Community Advocacy & Climate Policy

- [Advocate for Zero Energy and Zero Carbon Communities](https://zeroenergyproject.com/advocate/advocate-zero-energy-zero-carbon-communities): Community advocacy guide for zero energy and zero carbon initiatives
- [Implementing the Paris Accords: Zero Energy Homes will Lead the Way](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2016/01/25/implementing-the-paris-accords-zero-energy-homes-will-lead-the-way): Paris Climate Accords implementation via zero energy homes and building codes
- [States Take the Lead in Climate Action](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2017/12/29/states-take-lead-climate-action): Oregon, California, Washington lead state-level climate policy initiatives
- [Getting to Zero Carbon in Menlo Park](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2017/02/11/getting-zero-carbon-menlo-park): Menlo Park's climate action plan for zero carbon city development

## Case Studies & Industry Innovation

- [Elemental Green and the Zero Energy Project Join Forces to Accelerate Zero Carbon Homes](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2022/10/06/elemental-green-and-the-zero-energy-project-join-forces-to-accelerate-zero-carbon-homes): Elemental Green and Zero Energy Project partnership announcement
- [Launching California's Largest Zero Energy Community](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2017/11/07/launching-californias-largest-zero-energy-community): De Young Properties launches California's largest zero energy community
- [Imery Homes - A Systematic Approach to Zero Energy Home Construction](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2018/06/17/imery-homes-a-systematic-approach-to-zero-energy-home-construction): Luis Imery's systematic approach to affordable zero energy home building
- [Demand Response Technology: Key to Decarbonizing Multifamily](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2023/06/23/demand-response-technology-key-to-decarbonizing-multifamily): Demand response tech for multifamily decarbonization and grid management
- [Disrupting the Energy Industry with the Energy Technology Trifecta](https://zeroenergyproject.com/2017/02/11/disrupting-industry-energy-technology-trifecta): Solar, storage, and EVs disrupting utility industry business models
